name: 市场（比较/收益/成本）适用

map.💰 市场（比较/收益/成本）适用: 💰 Applicability of Sales Comparison, Income and Cost Approaches
map.根据物业特征、数据条件与市场环境，量化评估市场比较法、收益法、成本法三种估价方法: Quantify how far the sales comparison, income and cost approaches fit, given the property's characteristics, data availability and market conditions.
map.📖 查看「市场（比较/收益/成本）适用 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Applicability of Sales Comparison, Income and Cost Approaches User Guide"
map.无收益或收益极不稳定: No income or highly unstable income
map.丰富（租金、售价、成本均可得）: Rich (rent, price and cost all available)
map.💡 评估逻辑：市场比较法看重交易活跃度与案例可得性；收益法看重稳定收益与运营数据: 💡 Logic: the sales comparison approach depends on transaction activity and comparable availability; the income approach on stable income and operating data; the cost approach suits new builds, special uses or assets whose income cannot be reliably estimated.
map.结果为方法适用性的量化参考，非绝对判断: Results quantify method fit and are not an absolute judgement
map.实际估价报告通常以一种方法为主、其他方法为辅: Real reports usually lead with one method and support it with others
map.特殊用途资产可能还需采用假设开发法或基准地价修正法: Special-purpose assets may also need the hypothetical development or base land price adjustment method
map.最终方法选择应由持证估价师根据具体委托目的确定: The final choice of method rests with the licensed appraiser and the specific purpose of the engagement
map.📚 深度解析：估价方法适用度评估: 📚 In-depth: Assessing Which Valuation Method Fits
map.根据物业特征选择首选估价方法。: Choose a primary valuation method from the property's characteristics.
map.市场交易清淡时从比较法转向成本法。: When the market is thin, move from comparison to the cost approach.
map.收益稳定物业优先收益法。: Give the income approach priority for stable-income property.
map.住宅、市场活跃、数据丰富、交易目的 → 市场比较法适用度最高（如 80%+），建: Residential, active market, rich data, transaction purpose: the sales comparison approach fits best (80%+), so lead with comparison and support it with the income approach.
map.若收益稳定可预测（如长租约），收益法适用度升至 15% 权重档、比较法下降，建议: With stable, predictable income (long leases, say), the income approach rises to the 15% weight band and comparison falls, so lead with the income approach.
map.三种方法必须都用吗？: Must all three methods be used?
map.不强制，但规范鼓励两种以上交叉验证；至少应选一种最适用方法并说明不选其他的原因。: Not mandatory, but standards encourage cross-checking with two or more; at least pick the most suitable method and explain why the others were not used.
map.新建或无交易的特殊资产以成本法为主，必要时辅以假设开发法，并在报告中论证。: Lead with the cost approach for new or untraded special assets, supporting it with the hypothetical development method where needed, and justify it in the report.
map.关于「市场（比较/收益/成本）适用」: About "Applicability of Sales Comparison, Income and Cost Approaches"
map.房地产三大估价方法适用性判断工具。通过物业类型、市场活跃度、收益稳定性、开发阶段: A tool for judging which of the three main valuation approaches applies. It scores six dimensions - property type, market activity, income stability, development stage, data availability and purpose - and recommends a primary and secondary method.
map.三种方法适用度可视化: Visual fit scores for the three methods
map.给出方法选择说明: Gives the rationale for method choice
map.抵押/交易/课税估价辅助: Support for mortgage, transaction and tax valuation
